decisions.statement: The record worked is the one whose named field states the text handed in.
A field stated anew to name a page that is not there refuses the answer.
A key with no record is refused.
Text no record states under that field is refused.
Text more than one record states under that field is refused.
That refusal says how many records state it.
A record stating no text under the field worked is refused.
The passage answered is the lines the field's value sits on rather than the body.

definition: one field of one record a page's many-valued property has, stated anew
